verdict.line: You lose if Kled catches you with Jousting plus Bear Trap before level 3; you win almost two-thirds of the time once you reach level 3 and start punishing his dismounts.

brief.thesis: The whole lane hinges on Kled's E (Jousting): he dashes in, can recast it to dash back through you, and that double-dash is where his solo-kill threat lives before Illaoi has W or E online. Once you hit level 3 and can force Test of Spirit the instant he commits his dash, the fight flips hard in your favor, which is why Illaoi sits at 64.4% over 45 games here despite OP.GG calling the lane even on paper.

theirWindow.what: Kled can Q (Bear Trap) to hook and yank you, then Joust (E) in and back out again. Don't stand in hook range on cooldown and don't trade face-to-face until you have Test of Spirit to punish the second dash.

yourWindow.when: Skaarl's HP hits zero and Kled dismounts
yourWindow.what: Dismounted Kled deals less damage to champions and loses his hook for a knockback Pocket Pistol. Jump in with W (Harsh Lesson) immediately and follow with E (Test of Spirit) to turn him into a Vessel while he's weak.

runes.keystoneWhy: Highest-measured page (69.2% win rate, 38.2% pick) — the proc sustain keeps you healthy through early Bear Trap poke before you have E online.

summoners.why: Highest-measured combo here at 72.7% win rate and the top pick rate (48.5%) — Teleport resets the wave after you get poked off it early, Flash answers the Jousting return dash.

playing.title: Don't trade before level 3
playing.detail: Before Test of Spirit is up you have no answer to the Bear Trap into Jousting combo; let passive Tentacles do the chipping and avoid standing in hook range.

playing.title: Watch Skaarl's HP bar
playing.detail: Once Skaarl's health depletes Kled dismounts, deals less damage to champions, and swaps his Q for a knockback Pocket Pistol. That's your all-in window — go in with W then E.

playing.title: Time your E to his dash
playing.detail: Don't fire Test of Spirit on cooldown. Wait until he commits Jousting to close distance, then rip his spirit so the echoed damage punishes the dash back through you.

playing.title: Fight near impassable terrain
playing.detail: Your passive spawns Tentacles on nearby walls — pick trade spots next to them so they swing on him for free while he's forced to path around.

playing.title: Build Black Cleaver into Iceborn Gauntlet
playing.detail: This is the measured 66.7% win-rate core order; it shreds Skaarl's armor so your W and Q trades scale through the 6-11 window.

playing.title: Save R for his dives
playing.detail: Leap of Faith spawns a Tentacle for every champion it hits, so baiting his all-in into your ult around level 6 turns his dive into a lost fight.

playing.title: Punish Violent Tendencies with armor
playing.detail: His W is a four-hit attack-speed burst with a heavier fourth attack — Plated Steelcaps and later Thornmail blunt it directly.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate figures are pulled from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.20.1); the tactical reasoning — when to hold E, how to play the dismount window, where to stand for Tentacles — is this brief's own analysis layered on top.

stats.opponentTip: Illaoi can contest with Kled only if she is careful before reaching level 3. Do not use [E] recklessly as Kled can use (E) once again if (E) landed on Illaoi; rather, we recommend using [E] the moment Kled uses (E) to close in.
